title: Maximal Area Quadrilateral
statementMd:
Iahub has drawn a set of $*n*$ points in the cartesian plane which he calls "special points". A quadrilateral is a simple polygon without self-intersections with four sides (also called edges) and four vertices (also called corners). Please note that a quadrilateral doesn't have to be convex. A special quadrilateral is one which has all four vertices in the set of special points. Given the set of special points, please calculate the maximal area of a special quadrilateral.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($4 ≤ *n* ≤ 300$). Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains two integers: $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ $( - 1000 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 1000)$ — the cartesian coordinates of $*i*$th special point. It is guaranteed that no three points are on the same line. It is guaranteed that no two points coincide.

## Output

Output a single real number — the maximal area of a special quadrilateral. The answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does't exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

## Note

In the test example we can choose first $4$ points to be the vertices of the quadrilateral. They form a square by side $4$, so the area is $4·4 = 16$.
statementZhMd:
Iahub 在笛卡尔平面上画了一组 $*n*$ 个点，并将其称为“特殊点”。四边形是一种没有自交、具有四条边（也称为边）和四个顶点（也称为角）的简单多边形。请注意，四边形不一定是凸的。如果一个四边形的四个顶点都属于特殊点集合，则称其为特殊四边形。给定特殊点集合，请计算特殊四边形的最大面积。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$4 ≤ *n* ≤ 300$）。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数：$*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$（$ - 1000 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），表示第 $*i*$ 个特殊点的笛卡尔坐标。保证不存在三点共线。保证不存在两个点重合。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数，即特殊四边形的最大面积。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则视为正确。

## 说明

在样例中，我们可以选择前 $4$ 个点作为四边形的顶点。它们组成一个边长为 $4$ 的正方形，因此面积为 $4·4 = 16$。
